prompts.ryu:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: newly DRAWN animation sprite sheet for an existing detailed pixel-art fighting game. Use the reference ONLY to preserve this one fighter's exact face, hairstyle, costume, colors and crisp detailed arcade pixel-art finish; replace its old poses entirely. Character: blue sleeveless ninja, red scarf, steel forearm guards: compact guarded sliding steps, quick straight punch, side kick, rising fist. Output a square 2048x2048 transparent PNG containing EXACTLY 8 columns and 8 rows, 64 equal 256x256 cells, one full-body sprite per cell. All 64 sprites face RIGHT. No camera or scale changes. Same hip/root center at local x=112, ground baseline y=230 in EVERY cell. Standing height about 180 pixels. Keep all arms, feet, hair, weapons within each cell with 12-pixel clear gutters. NO grid lines, labels, shadows, floor, text, trails or background. True alpha transparency.
Rows 1 and 2 TOGETHER: one continuous 16-frame forward fighting walk loop read left to right then next row. A grounded guarded shuffle, NOT running: lead heel reaches gently, weight rolls heel-to-toe, trailing foot pushes, feet gather without crossing, rear heel lifts, next step settles. Both hands maintain guard. Bent knees, natural alternating support, tiny 2-3 pixel vertical bob. First 8 frames first half step, next8 complete return to identical starting stance; no duplicated static poses.
Rows 3 and 4 TOGETHER: independent 16-frame BACKWARD guarded walk loop, still facing RIGHT throughout, NOT mirrored forward walk. Rear foot reaches LEFT first, torso stays oriented RIGHT guarding opponent, front foot draws backward into stance, controlled toe-to-heel transfer. No crossing feet or turning around.
Row 5: 8 unique progressive attack frames: guard, shoulder/hip windup, halfway extension, fully extended punch or sword strike at opponent chest, follow-through, elbow folds, recoil settles, guard. Anatomically plausible arm length, attack tip around x=230,y=108.
Row 6: 8 unique progressive side/front kick frames: guard, knee chamber, partial extension, fully extended kick with support foot pivot, held follow-through, knee retracts, foot lowers, guard. Foot tip around x=230,y=124. No extra limbs.
Row 7: 8 unique rising attack frames: crouch load, hips drive, rising arm/knee/sword, full upward extension, apex, controlled descending pose, knees cushion landing, return guard. Keep all poses within cell, root axis consistent; jump is animated in engine so do not float the whole character above baseline.
Row 8: 8 unique recoil sequence frames: guarded neutral, shoulders jolt backward, head/chest recoil, maximum weight shift onto rear foot, knees catch balance, guard comes back, torso settles, neutral.
Draw actual different limb and joint poses for each frame, not stretched copies, morphs or blurred duplicates. Preserve coherent body volume, pixel clusters and outfit construction across the complete sheet. Seamless walk cycles; natural human body mechanics. This is usable game production sprite artwork, not a poster.
